title: Reasoning-Aware Relational Representation Learning for Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.13496v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Generation (OV-SGG) requires models to recognize visual relationships beyond the training vocabulary, yet existing methods often rely on dataset-specific object--predicate co-occurrence patterns. Under long-tailed distributions and noisy object localization, such reliance leads to biased, entangled relation representations, limiting both rare-relation recognition and generalization to unseen predicates. To address these challenges, we propose RaRe, a reasoning-aware relational representation learning framework that transforms MLLM-generated chain-of-thought (CoT) rationales into structured relation embeddings. Rather than using CoT only as an intermediate reasoning trace for final prediction, RaRe directly optimizes the rationale-derived representation space to improve inter-relation discriminability. translated_title: 面向开放词汇场景图生成的推理感知关系表示学习
translated_abstract: 开放词汇场景图生成要求模型能够识别超出训练词汇表范围之外的视觉关系，然而现有方法往往依赖于特定数据集中对象—谓词的共现模式。在长尾分布和含噪声的对象定位条件下，这种依赖会导致关系表示产生偏差且相互纠缠，既限制了稀有关系的识别能力，也限制了对未见谓词的泛化能力。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 RaRe，一种推理感知的关系表示学习框架，它将多模态大语言模型（MLLM）生成的思维链推理依据转化为结构化的关系嵌入。RaRe 并非仅将思维链作为最终预测的中间推理轨迹，而是直接优化由推理依据导出的表示空间，以提升不同关系之间的可区分性。具体而言，RaRe 首先通过自监督学习将推理依据嵌入与文本化的关系描述进行对齐……
tldr: 提出 RaRe 框架，将 MLLM 生成的思维链推理依据直接转化为并优化为结构化关系嵌入，从而提升开放词汇场景图生成中稀有关系的识别能力和对未见谓词的泛化能力。
